frontend.note: 24 distinct cases passed across staged runs; this is not a claim of a single clean 24-case run. Raw reports/traces remain ignored local artifacts. A final desktop catalog repeat additionally passed after its scroll-container fix.

corrections: Map controls overlapped hospital details on desktop; repositioned controls.
Detail illustration intercepted close button; raised close button.
Phone details overlapped map controls; moved controls above details.
Phone catalog overflowed the page; constrained table to a focusable scroll region and added a populated-catalog width assertion.
Manual export assertion used Plan DTO coverage key; corrected to export DTO projected/additional.
Focused onboarding tests used an unsupported helper signature; corrected before full 122-test pass.
Initial backend run lacked repository fixture paths, then shared-container restart interrupted it; final full validation used a separate container with repository mounted.
A production build was locked by the preview server; stopped that server before rebuilding.
Split-host CORS omitted DELETE; added it and verified configured-origin preflight.
limits: Phone checks use Chromium emulation, not physical-device Safari/WebKit.
New PostgreSQL-enabled suite and combined network-disabled image are assigned to final CI; prior merged CI is only a baseline.
Catalog tests are informational; automated routing remains reviewed primary-care OPD.
City roads, context buildings and heights are illustrative, not surveyed geometry.
No hosting project/account access or public HTTPS deployment/restart evidence has been supplied.
PR review, final CI and merge remain separate from local acceptance.
